fix_hunks.annotation: Every progress event is sanitized before caching or WebSocket broadcast, and the cache write is tied to the requesting builder.
Completed results are sanitized before both the progress event and HTTP response, while cache cleanup is scoped to the same builder.
Status polling now reads only the requesting builder's cached automation result.
The sanitizer deep-copies a result and removes OAuth2 data from trigger, step, or action output without mutating execution state.
The progress cache key now includes the builder ID, preventing two builders in one app from sharing an automation-test slot.
Read and delete operations use the same user-scoped key as writes, completing cache isolation across the full lifecycle.

squash_audit.flaw_origin: Copilot-coauthored commit a0e6108842a3bfc840a33db819a4415fbdac333d added the TypeScript file-reference loader without an allowed-root boundary.

row.mechanism: The TypeScript loader resolved file references relative to a prompt and read the result without proving that the target remained inside an authorized directory.
row.scope_statement: Count only the Copilot-assisted TypeScript runtime surface; pre-existing Python behavior and the C# and Rust ports are outside this row.

code_evidence.summary: A Copilot-assisted TypeScript loader read file references without checking where they resolved. A malicious prompt could use an absolute path or traversal to read files available to the host process.
code_evidence.mechanism: The file-reference branch joined attacker-controlled text to the prompt directory and passed the resulting path straight to a synchronous file read.

steps.title: AI change
steps.detail: The new TypeScript runtime added file-reference expansion with no authorized-root check.

steps.title: Security fix
steps.detail: The fix enforces canonical allowed roots and rechecks the real target to stop both traversal and symlink escape.

candidate_hunks.annotation: The new loader chooses the prompt directory as a base but defines no allowed-root policy.
A file reference is resolved and immediately read, so absolute paths and traversal can escape the prompt directory.

fix_hunks.annotation: The fix imports canonical-path and relative-path primitives and adds an explicit option for trusted extra roots.
Loading now accepts the root policy and carries it into agent construction.
Agent construction receives the root policy together with the prompt path.
Agent construction passes the same root policy into reference preprocessing.
The prompt directory and any explicitly trusted roots are canonicalized before reference expansion.
The file protocol now uses the guarded resolver instead of reading the directly resolved path.
The resolver rejects lexical escape, verifies existence, canonicalizes the target, and checks again to block symlink escape.
